headline: EXCITEBIKE: the league turns solid
lede: Bikes are no longer ghosts. Rear-end a rival at speed and you get bumped off their wheel; ride into a downed rider and the wreck holds the lane until he walks it back — or you fly over him and get paid for it.

notes.text: Contact law live: solid wrecks (wipeout or hold, never a ride-through), momentum-transferring bumps, swerving jolts, and a 150pt once-per-pass FLYBY over any rider. One drama per pair keeps it racing, not derbies.

Two real bugs fell out: a remount on steep whoops used to re-crash forever (recover now seats the pitch on the slope), and the autopilot braked to a stop at crash scenes — with a delayed-hop sweep it now flybys wrecks, byte-exact in the attract demo.

excitecheck 103 (139 with --mutate, six new contact mutants, all die); exciteplay 32 in-tab proofs including a real SPACE hop over a real wreck; MOTOCROSS receipts show the pack being passed entirely on the air.
Red main (watchcheck TidyBot pin) was repaired by the parallel lane mid-shift (#2396); merge queue cleared and shipped behind it.
